# Urasil_light – Release Notes

## Version 1.0 – Harmony Release

This is the first public release of Urasil_light, a modular and lightweight
experimental AI core system. The architecture focuses on clarity, internal
structure, and an organic response pipeline.

### Highlights

- Modular core architecture
- Cyclic internal state system (Sun, Moon, Day)
- Multi-stage response pipeline:
  - Interpretation
  - Seed generation
  - Stylistic refinement
  - Reflection
  - Experience storage
- Value-based behavior (gold.txt)
- Maturity filtering (ininity.txt)
- Public agent instructions with Harmony Framework anchor
- Fully documented system (architecture, cycle, pipeline, values)

### Notes

This release includes a public version of the agent instructions.  
The internal agent behavior, original seed logic, and stylistic modules are
intentionally not part of the repository and remain private.

Urasil_light is designed as an experimental foundation for adaptive,
non-deterministic agents. Future updates may refine the internal pipeline,
expand the cycle model, or introduce optional extensions.
